title: rhythm-check-1to1-spark-notes-mila-chen-apr18-2028
content:
Context: quick rhythm check before our regular 1:1. Arjun moved into a new ownership area (inference latency optimizations) last sprint — want to ensure goals, blockers, and growth signals are aligned. I'm keeping this lightweight: 25 minute target.

Meeting logistics
- Duration: 25 minutes (start on time)
- Location: Zoom + write notes in this doc (I will share links after)
- Goal: unblock this sprint, set one measurable outcome for next week, pick a personal development micro-task

Top-line agenda (25m)
1) 2m — Temperature check: one sentence on energy / load / wins
2) 6m — Progress on sprint priority: JIRA-1027 (kv-cache warmup improvements) + perf numbers seen in staging
3) 6m — Blockers & ops: infra flakiness during high-concurrency tests; PR review queue; CI timeout root cause
4) 6m — Career / growth: review proposed shadowing rotation with SRE (2 weeks), feedback cadence, upward mentorship plan
5) 5m — Decisions & next steps: concrete action items and owners

Notes-to-self / prompts to surface during check-in
- Ask: what small change would give the biggest reduction in tokens-per-request or tail latency? Push for a single experimental metric to track this week.
- Listen for: language about being 'blocked' vs 'waiting on help' — if blocked, escalate; if waiting, coach on next ping step.
- Encourage: pick a micro experiment (e.g., tune batching policy N=8 -> 12 for chat flows) and run a canary on Dedicated pool.

Progress snapshot (what I know before meeting)
- JIRA-1027: Arjun's branch folded into staging; initial test runs show 6% average latency drop but tail (p99) increased by ~3% under burst load.
- PR review: runtime PRs pending review: #844 (long tensor-copy fix) - awaiting infra review; #850 (kv-cache eviction logic) - needs integration test added.
- Infra: last Friday there were two ~5min outages in the west region during autoscaling events (post-mortem draft exists).

Blockers to escalate if still present
- Autoscaler misconfig causing node churn during sustained burst — if not resolved, propose temporary cap on scale-up in prod to avoid oscillation.
- PR review backlog: propose a 90-minute review blitz with dev + infra to clear the critical queue.
- E2E flaky test: determine whether the flakiness is test-cohort (data seeded) or infra-related — ask Devika for a repro script.

Career & growth prompts (6m)
- Shadowing: propose 2-week SRE pairing to learn incident runbooks and the autoscaler codepath. Benefit: better cross-team debugging and fewer escalations.
- Feedback cadence: encourage Arjun to request 2 small feedback commits from peers per sprint (code and design).
- Mentorship: ask if Arjun is interested in mentoring an intern for the summer; note: good signal for leadership readiness.

Concrete actions (from previous 1:1) — status
- Arjun: add integration test for kv-cache eviction (owner: Arjun) — IN PROGRESS, needs infra test harness (blocked by CI token).
- Me (Mila): schedule review blitz with infra — DONE (scheduled Thu 10:00).
- Follow-up: write short playbook for autoscaler debugging — TODO (I will draft baseline by Fri).

New action items (assign and due date)
- Arjun: run targeted p99 tail experiment with adjusted batching policy and post results in the thread (due: 2028-04-25)
- Arjun + Devika: reproduce E2E flaky test and attach minimal repro to JIRA-1029 (due: 2028-04-22)
- Mila: add temporary autoscaler knob to prod config to limit scale-up while we debug (owner: Mila, coordinate with infra) (due: 2028-04-20)
- Mila: draft 1-page shadowing plan for SRE rotation and share with Arjun + Sarah (director) (due: 2028-04-24)

Decision checklist (if needed in meeting)
- If repro shows infra root cause -> open SEV and pause Dedicated bursts until fix confirmed.
- If kv-cache integ tests keep failing -> roll back to previous eviction policy and ship a post-mortem with timeline.

Signals to watch (metrics / logs)
- p50, p95, p99 for text-generation endpoint (compare canary vs baseline)
- GPU utilization during burst window (sustained > 85% for > 2m indicates possible hot-shard)
- Autoscaler event frequency (events/hour) and churn ratio
- PR review queue age for runtime labels

Questions I want Arjun to answer / think about
- Given the 6% avg latency gain but p99 increase, which trade-offs are tolerable for the product team? Where do we draw the 'no-fry' line?
- Which observability gaps made debugging slow last week? Which one do we fix first?
- Are you comfortable leading the SRE pairing? Any constraints we should plan for?

Notes after the 1:1 (fill in during/after)
- Energy check: (Arjun) "energized but stretched" — note: check in mid-week asynchronously.
- Decision made: run batching N=12 canary for 24h on Dedicated west pool; Mila to add temporary scale-up cap.
- New action added: Arjun to document the experiment as a runbook snippet in repo (folder: docs/experiments).

Follow-up template I will use in Slack (short)
- TL;DR: Ran canary for batching N=12 in west Dedicated pool to address kv-cache warmup. Arjun to run p99 checks; Mila added temporary scale-up cap. Next touchpoint Wed EOD with results.

Tags / quick links to paste in convo
- JIRA-1027 (kv-cache warmup), JIRA-1029 (e2e-flake), PR#844, infra postmortem: drive link (will paste after PM draft is finalized)

Notes to self (manager coaching)
- Avoid solving too quickly: ask clarifying questions before offering action.
- Make sure to surface visible wins to leadership if p99 improves after canary.
- Keep the growth ask specific (shadow + mentor intern) so Arjun has discrete deliverables to show.

End of prep. Will capture meeting notes inline and update linked JIRA tickets post-meeting.

-- Mila
